verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud lets you start agent runs through an API (`client.runs.create`) that execute remotely without supervision. You monitor them by polling `runs.events()`, and saved login profiles, automatic CAPTCHA solving and stealth browsers keep runs going without human input. A community user also reports running ongoing LinkedIn automation. However, the evidence only shows on-demand, API-triggered runs, not configurable automations: there is no scheduling, recurring triggers or completion notifications, and 2FA or unsolved CAPTCHAs still require a human checkpoint. Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring or event-triggered automations, webhook/push notifications on completion, fully unattended handling of 2FA, independent hands-on corroboration of long-running background operation.
